question: Does the frozen primary chiral-EFT authority set provide a regulator- and renormalization-scheme-independent hard upper bound on renormalized contact/two-body weak-current strength?
scope_guard: Negative audit of the frozen authority set only; not a theorem that no universal bound can ever be derived.
hard_bound_requirements: theory-derived finite inequality or interval rather than naturalness
cross-target applicability without refitting a free coefficient
propagatable through the frozen 0048 amplitude-to-power bridge

authorities.title: Three-Nucleon Low-Energy Constants from the Consistency of Interactions and Currents in Chiral Effective Field Theory
authorities.frozen_finding: c_D and c_E are constrained/determined from A=3 binding energies and triton beta decay; this is calibration from observables, not a theory-derived universal coefficient ceiling.

authorities.title: Nuclear Axial Currents in Chiral Effective Field Theory
authorities.frozen_finding: Two-nucleon axial operators and contact structures are derived; ultraviolet divergences and renormalization/contact terms are part of the construction. No regulator/scheme-independent finite universal coefficient/operator-norm upper bound is provided.

authorities.title: Nuclear axial current operators to fourth order in chiral effective field theory
authorities.frozen_finding: Renormalized one-, two-, and three-nucleon axial operators are derived; unitary ambiguity is controlled by renormalizability and matching to nuclear forces. Renormalized operator construction does not furnish a universal finite upper bound on the matched short-range LEC/operator norm.

authorities.title: Towards consistent nuclear interactions from chiral Lagrangians II: Symmetry preserving regularization
authorities.frozen_finding: Consistent forces and currents require symmetry-preserving cutoff regularization; regulator construction is an explicit part of the EFT. This supports the prereg distinction between renormalized consistency and a regulator-independent numerical hard ceiling; no such ceiling is supplied.

authorities.title: Discrepancy between experimental and theoretical beta-decay rates resolved from first principles
authorities.frozen_finding: Representative ab-initio many-body/two-body-current phenomenology is retained only as empirical evidence-distance, never as a universal maximum.

next_action: Move to the next independent class-level survivor; highest-value candidate is the genuinely long-range/growing-coordination Standard-Model residual, while preserving the contact-coefficient residual OPEN.
